description: Nomid staff only (Nomid system admins; refused for everyone else). Reads one device's stored documents as they are in the database, every field included: asset (with asset.managedDevice, the device as last reported: appsReport with each app's keyedAppStates, events, hardware, network, memory and power events, non-compliance) and currentStatus (the agent's reports: nomidApps, checkups, appMetadata, battery, screen, foreground app, last location). Use packageName for one app's report and keyed states. A document too large for one result comes in parts: value has what fits, notShown lists what needs its own call with its path, and when nextFromIndex is present call again with fromIndex = nextFromIndex. Values that are secrets are replaced by {"redacted": true}, and so is an install error's raw body (installErrorCode stays). Use company to name the company; another customer's device needs an "All Nomid customers" connection. Prefer get_device or diagnose unless you need a field they omit.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

fromIndex.description: When a result carries nextFromIndex: pass it here for the rest. Default 0.

packageName.description: Optional, instead of path: that app's entry in the device's app report, with its keyedAppStates.

path.description: Optional. JSON Pointer of the part to read, as in notShown: /asset/managedDevice/appsReport, /currentStatus/nomidApps. Default: the whole document.

name: read_device_document
title: Read a device's whole stored document (Nomid staff)
